study type: Pooled analysis of two clinical trials
exposure: method of preparation of microbiota from stool using automatic system
delivery method of colonic transendoscopic enteral tubing
cohort: The study included 109 patients with moderate-to-severe ulcerative colitis (Mayo score range 6-12) who participated in two clinical trials.
finding: Fecal microbiota transplantation appears to be a safe and promising therapy for ulcerative colitis, with 74.3% achieving clinical response at 1 month and 51.4% at 3 months, and specific preparation and delivery methods associated with a lower rate of adverse events.
